shows.title: NJE ETIGBO
shows.host: OBA MAJALA, BODE EDOGBEMI, ANIKE ADE
shows.description:
A daily Yoruba newspaper review segment that examines, interprets, and discusses major stories making the headlines in Nigerian newspapers.

The segment brings newspaper content closer to Yoruba-speaking listeners by presenting important national, political, economic, social, and community-related stories in Yoruba.

It gives listeners an opportunity to understand the stories behind the headlines, discuss their implications, and appreciate how current developments affect everyday life.

shows.title: LAWUJO WA
shows.host: OBA MAJALA, FEYIKEMI NIYI,BODE EDOGBEMI & FUNSHO ADEMIGBUJI
shows.description:
LAWUJO is a social discussion and public affairs programme that focuses on issues affecting society, from the national level to communities and local neighbourhoods.

The programme examines trending events, social developments, public concerns, government policies, community challenges, and everyday issues that affect people's lives.

What makes LAWUJO engaging is its interactive approach. We don't just discuss issues; we create room for public participation, expert opinions, and meaningful conversations.
